entities.name: Suō no Naishi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Suō no Naishi  was a Japanese waka poet of the late-Heian period. One of her poems was included in the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu, and thirty-five in imperial collections. She also produced a private waka collection, the Suō no Naishi-shū.
